reference_observations.description: Hunt’s hybridism information is used by the completed chapter by December 29, 1857; no exact receipt follows. Missing Pintail notes and refusal to rely on memory remain explicit.
Retain after-July-12 dating and the disputed 1843 contextual versus 1845 watermark evidence. Missing Holland note and Isaac account are not replaced by Owen’s later publication.
Hinrichs fears the French résumé was lost and sends English material; dispatch and requested distribution do not prove Darwin receipt or endorsement.
Receipt of German Variation volume one does not establish receipt of both volumes; planned publications and dispatches remain future.
The institutional appeal reports 71 cases and 53 satisfactory outcomes. The account’s £1 10s combines causes and cannot be assigned wholly to this society.

corrections.description: Howitt’s January 10, 1881 report to Fison summarizes a missing Darwin letter; it is not a quotation of Darwin’s full body. Initial glancing and forwarding of the 1880 book precede promised careful reading after its return.
Van Zouteveen is translating Descent, not Variation. His questions, English prose and French Reclus quotation remain distinct; querying Reclus’s reliability is not endorsing that account.

Keep Charles’s cover separate from the embedded August 5, 1867 Swinhoe material and attributed Gisbert observation. Carrying fruit is reported; rolling to acquire it and return to a hole are inferential parts of the chain.
The memorandum was printed by George Henslow in 1866. Related May 1857 observations do not establish that this exact published wording was available in 1857.
Prior reading establishes an 1861 Innes fragment with temporary household accommodation and sting observations; missing ends do not justify moving it into 1851–1855.
An earlier accepted primary witness 489 establishes knowledge of Herbert’s gift by January 20, 1839. The worker’s no-response statement is only packet-local and must not erase this earlier evidence.
The South America volume is three-quarters done, not completed. The source fraction and qualified dating remain explicit.
Preserve the October 7 Sunday versus Monday October 8 conflict. Prior Hooker forwarding evidence remains date-qualified; no exact day is silently chosen.
Preserve the MathML one-and-a-half hours and seven surviving children versus eight births. The Ipswich portrait is now available, not merely a future promise.
Medical, family, publishing and financial subject matter are not exclusion rules. Rejection of a new edge depends on the actual missing counterpart, date, source scope or attribution.

summary: Fourteen targets and ten contexts reuse matched accepted primary readings, with a fresh full reread of 12874F confirming reported rather than verbatim Darwin wording. No new period graph edges. Hunt 2096 is a 1857 knowledge lead. Broad Henslow, Herbert and Holland date cases remain held. Earlier source use, missing originals, partial reading, translated quotation and publication layers remain distinct.
